title: 14th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
summary: The speaker argues that PEGA is a leader in a fast-growing industry with a clear path to profitability, projecting a transition to be completed by 2022 with improved margins. They believe Avalara is significantly underappreciated regarding its moat and growth potential, recommending a long position. Conversely, the speaker holds a bearish view on Google, predicting it will remain a lead generation business rather than building a network of service professionals.

claims.claim: PEGA is among the leaders in a fast-growing industry with a serviceable market of around $80 billion, expected to grow at 18% CAGR.
claims.quote: our first thesis is that pega is among the leaders in a fast growing industry the term is around 80 billion of which 50 billion are serviceable for pega considering client size and verticals and this serviceable market will grow at 18 percent category

claims.claim: PEGA's base case conservatively scales PEGA Cloud gross margins to 72.5% by 2026, resulting in an overall gross margin for PEGA around 79% at exit.
claims.quote: our base case conservatively scales pig cloud gross margins to 72.5 by 2026 and the net result is an overall gross margin for pega around 79 at our exit

claims.claim: The speaker's base case price target for PEGA is $310 based on 7.5x 2026 revenues, assuming multiples slightly approaching its two-year historical average.
claims.quote: so our base case price target of 310 dollars is based on seven and a half times 2026 revenues which assumes the multiple contracts slightly approaching its two-year historical average

claims.claim: In the bold case, the speaker thinks PEGA's valuation will reflect a 10x even revenue multiple and an IRR of 34% over five years as the business transition is completed.
claims.quote: in our bold case we think this translates to a 10 times even revenue multiple and an ir of 34 over five years

claims.claim: Sales and marketing as a percentage of total revenue will decrease from 52% to 39%, and operating margin will expand from negative 6% to 21%.
claims.quote: sales and marketing as a percentage of total revenue will decrease from 52 percent to 39 percent and ebay margin will expand from negative six percent to 21

claims.claim: PEGA has a terrific product, a sneaky customer base, and a clear path to the future, with the transition expected to be done in 2022.
claims.quote: pega has a terrific product a sneaky customer base with a clear path to the future it's a visionary challenger in the sas place

claims.claim: PEGA has performed better than Adobe during the transition so far, having no years of negative revenue growth and exiting on a trajectory very similar to Adobe.
claims.quote: peg has actually performed better than adobe during the transition so far and so they've had no years of negative revenue growth and they're exiting the transition on a trajectory very similar to adobe

claims.claim: The speaker believes Google will not invest to build a network of service professionals and will remain a lead generation business, allowing competitors to disintermediate them.
claims.quote: once you kind of move it off app and kind of develop this habit then you kind of disintermediate google and google is not going to be in the business of being able to source supply they're consistently just want to be a lead gen business

claims.claim: The speaker mentions HomeAdvisor or Angie's List as top suppliers but does not express a specific investment view on RH.
claims.quote: yeah home advisor or angie's usually one of the first two or three at the top of the list and that's why people have historically called them a google arbitrage place

claims.claim: The speaker recommends a long position on Avalara with a price target of $850, implying a six times return on money.
claims.quote: we're recommending a long on avalara with a price target of 850 dollars this implies a six times return on your money roughly 20 irr and a base case that exits at 20 30

claims.claim: The speaker believes Avalara's market is underappreciated regarding its moat, growth opportunities, and partnerships.
claims.quote: touching our variant view we think the market's under appreciating avalara's moat growth opportunities and the importance of its partnerships

claims.claim: The speaker projects Avalara's mid-market penetration will expand from single digits today to around 40 by 2030.
claims.quote: we think they can expand penetration from single digits today to around 40 by 2030

claims.claim: The speaker notes Avalara is currently trading at 19 times revenue.
claims.quote: then when it comes to valuation stocks currently trading at 19 times revenue
